name: DeepSeek Harness
summary: DeepSeek's open-source, plugin-based agent harness (dsh) with a local Web UI, a Python SDK and support for DeepSeek and third-party models.
description: Built on an "everything is a plugin" architecture using the Cordis framework. Run `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` to start the Web UI at http://127.0.0.1:3080, or build from source with pnpm. Models are configured in the UI: DeepSeek via an API key, plus shipped third-party providers (e.g. anthropic, openai, moonshotai, zai) or any custom model API. Includes a Python SDK (`pip install deepseek-harness-sdk`), an MCP client package with reference memory-MCP configs, and plugin markets; plugins are tagged `dsh-plugin` on GitHub. MIT licensed. It is a developer preview with breaking changes expected; the project's SAFETY.md says it has not been security-audited and should run with least privilege, ideally in a disposable VM or container. The npm package is at 0.2.1-rc.5 (Oct 2026).

agent_access.notes: Needs a model provider API key (DeepSeek or another provider) entered in Settings → Models.
